ask: We need to start building the CI GH -> Tailscale connection. I want to use this to sync openviking stuff. Howeever, the connection logic should be made such that the connection/login to localstack can be re-used for other purposes too (e.g. terraform plan/apply cycles etc, starting models, sending metrics to e.g. MLFlow from CI). Secondly, I don't want GH actions to hang when I sync documents. So here's what I want to do: Sync docs to either a bucket on seaweedFS or directly to Pub/Sub on cluster. If former, then docs should be picked up by queue and added when they land on the bucket. Ideally, we'd use an existing integration to do this. A go application would then take the documents from the queue and send them to OV in a controlled way, ensuring that it doesn't get overwhelmed and that failures are retried automatically.
